description_en: Creates a configuration group. A configuration group contains the configuration information of scheduled tasks in a Cloud Desktop center
description_zh: 创建配置组。配置组中包含云电脑中心定时任务的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-config-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name '定时任务组' --type Timer --product-type CLOUD_DESKTOP --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateConfigGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This feature is not region-specific. Set this parameter to `cn-shanghai`
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。该功能无地域属性，该字段固定填写`cn-shanghai`
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the configuration group
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the configuration group
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The type of the configuration group
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The product type used by the configuration group
parameters.help_zh: 配置组使用的产品类型
parameters.name: product_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow end users to configure scheduled tasks
fields.help_zh: 是否允许终端用户自行配置定时任务
fields.name: allow_client_setting

fields.help_en:
The cron expression of the scheduled task.

<notice>Specify the time in UTC. For example, to schedule a task at 00:00 (UTC+8) every day, use 0 0 16 ? * 1,2,3,4,5,6,7.</notice>
fields.help_zh:
定时任务Cron表达式。

<notice>需要传入UTC标准时间，即北京时间每天0点应该传入0 0 16 ? * 1,2,3,4,5,6,7></notice>
fields.name: cron_expression

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to forcefully execute the task
fields.help_zh: 是否强制执行
fields.name: enforce

fields.help_en: The time interval. Unit: minutes
fields.help_zh: 时间间隔，单位为分钟
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The advance notification time before the scheduled task is executed. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 定时任务执行前的通知提前时间。单位：秒
fields.name: notification_time

fields.help_en: The operation type of the scheduled task. Currently, only disconnect scheduled tasks support this parameter
fields.help_zh: 定时任务操作类型，目前仅断连定时任务支持
fields.name: operation_type

fields.help_en: The process whitelist for intelligent detection of no-operation scheduled tasks. If a specified process is running, the no-operation scheduled task is not triggered
fields.help_zh: 无操作定时任务智能判断的进程白名单，如果指定的进程正在运行则不支持无操作定时任务
fields.name: process_whitelist

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to create a snapshot
